```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Run a dry run without publishing'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Validate required secrets
        env:
          SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
          SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
          DOCKERHUB_USER: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -e
          missing=()
          for secret in SONATYPE_USERNAME SONATYPE_PASSWORD GPG_PRIVATE_KEY GPG_PASSPHRASE DOCKERHUB_USER DOCKERHUB_TOKEN RELEASE_TOKEN; do
            if [[ -z "${!secret}" ]]; then
              missing+=("$secret")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#missing[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Missing required secrets: ${missing[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Set up Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: 3.9.6

      - name: Import GPG key
        env:
          GPG_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$GPG_PRIVATE_KEY" | gpg --batch --import

      - name: Docker login
        env:
          DOCKERHUB_USER: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "$DOCKERHUB_TOKEN" | docker login -u "$DOCKERHUB_USER" --password-stdin

      - name: Capture old version
        id: old_version
        run: |
          echo "OLD_VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and publish
        env:
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
        run: |
          set -e
          MAVEN_FLAGS="-Prelease"
          if [[ "${{ inputs.dry_run }}" == "true" ]]; then
            MAVEN_FLAGS="$MAVEN_FLAGS -DskipDeploy -DskipJib"
          fi
          mvn $MAVEN_FLAGS -Dgpg.passphrase=${GPG_PASSPHRASE}

      - name: Capture new version
        id: new_version
        run: |
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update documentation
        run: |
          OLD_VERSION="${{ steps.old_version.outputs.OLD_VERSION }}"
          NEW_VERSION="${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}"
          echo "Updating docs from $OLD_VERSION to $NEW_VERSION"
          for file in $(git ls-files '*.md'); do
            sed -i "s/${OLD_VERSION}/${NEW_VERSION}/g" "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit documentation changes
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "docs: update version references to ${NEW_VERSION}"

      - name: Tag release
        run: |
          git tag -a "v${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}" -m "Release v${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}"

      - name: Push changes and tags
        env:
          RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${RELEASE_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
          git push origin v${{ steps.new_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}
```
